name: supervision-js-workspace
description: Workspace for the supervision-js core and browser packages.

scripts.build: npm run build -w supervision-js-core && npm run build -w supervision-js-react-native && npm run build -w supervision
scripts.build:js: npm run build:js -w supervision-js-core && npm run build:js -w supervision-js-react-native && npm run build:js -w supervision
scripts.build:types: npm run build:types -w supervision-js-core && npm run build:types -w supervision-js-react-native && npm run build:types -w supervision
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w supervision-js-core && npm run clean -w supervision-js-react-native && npm run clean -w supervision
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n lib,demo -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:lib" "npm run dev:demo"
scripts.dev:lib: concurrently -k -n core,rn,web -c blue,green,cyan "npm run dev -w supervision-js-core" "npm run dev -w supervision-js-react-native" "npm run dev -w supervision"
scripts.dev:demo-docs: npm run build && concurrently -k -n demo,docs -c magenta,blue "npm run dev:demo" "npm run docs:dev:server"
scripts.demo:dev: npm run build && npm run dev:demo
scripts.demo:build: npm run build && npm run build -w demo && npm run example:vanilla:build:app && npm run docs:build:typedoc
scripts.docs:build: npm run build && npm run docs:build:typedoc
scripts.example:vanilla:dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w examples/vanilla
scripts.example:vanilla:build: npm run build && npm run example:vanilla:build:app
scripts.example:react-native:dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w examples/react-native
scripts.example:react-native:dev-client: npm run build && npm run dev:client -w examples/react-native
scripts.example:react-native:dev-client:ios: npm run build && npm run dev:client:ios -w examples/react-native
scripts.example:react-native:dev-client:android: npm run build && npm run dev:client:android -w examples/react-native
scripts.example:react-native:dev-client:tunnel: npm run build && npm run dev:client:tunnel -w examples/react-native
scripts.example:react-native:ios: npm run build && npm run ios:build -w examples/react-native --
scripts.example:react-native:android: npm run build && npm run android:build -w examples/react-native --
scripts.fixture:sam3:build: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p tools/sam3-fixture/tsconfig.json && vite build --config tools/sam3-fixture/vite.config.ts
scripts.fixture:sam3:run: npm run build -w supervision-js-core && node tools/sam3-fixture/run-sam3.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w supervision-js-core && npm run build -w supervision-js-core && npm run typecheck -w supervision-js-react-native && npm run build -w supervision-js-react-native && npm run typecheck -w supervision && npm run build -w supervision && tsc --noEmit -p demo/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/vanilla/tsconfig.json && npm run example:react-native:typecheck
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run boundary:check && npm run docs:check && node --test tools/sam3-fixture/*.test.mjs tools/geometry-fixture/*.test.mjs
scripts.package:publish:dry-run: npm run package:tarball && npm publish ./artifacts/supervision-*.tgz --access public --tag latest --dry-run
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run package:smoke && npm run demo:build && npm run benchmark:initial:build && npm run benchmark:media-upload:build && npm run benchmark:masks:gpu:build
